
# **Tipping Study - pt.3 Demarcate movements**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(gsignal)

load(here::here("data", "proc", "02_out.rdata"))
```

Define movement bounds
---

#### Get 3d vector velocity

```{r}
hand_cols <- grep("_(x|y|z)", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

dt[,
  (paste0("delta_", hand_cols)) :=
    lapply(
      .SD,
      # get single-lagged differences
      \(col) col - shift(col, n = 1, type = "lag")
    ),
  .SDcols = hand_cols
] |>
  _[,
    velocity := sqrt(rowSums(.SD^2)) / (1 / 120),
    .SDcols = paste0("delta_", hand_cols)
  ] |>
  _[, (grep("^delta_", colnames(dt))) := NULL]
```

#### Smooth velocity values

```{r}
require(gsignal)

filt_order <- 4
samp <- 120
cutoff <- 10
nyq <- samp / 2
wn <- cutoff / nyq

buttbutt <- gsignal::butter(
  n = filt_order, w = wn, type = "low", output = "Sos"
)

dt[
  2:.N, # Fails if first row (NA) is included
  velocity := gsignal::filtfilt(buttbutt, velocity),
  by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num)
]
```

#### Compute acceleration

```{r}
dt[,
  acceleration := velocity - shift(velocity, n = 1, type = "lag"),
  by = .(participant, trial_num, block_num)
]
```

#### Get movement bounds

Create run length column counting consecutive rows wherein velocity >= 20 mm/s

Movement start defined as the first of four consecutive rows threshold is met.

```{r}
movement_bounds <- dt[,
  # Consider movement if velocity >= 20 mm/s
  .(moving = as.numeric(velocity >= 100 & acceleration >= 20)),
  keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num, frame)
] |>
  _[,
    # Get run lengths of "movement"
    runs := frollsum(moving, n = 4, align = "right"),
    keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)
  ] |>
  _[,
    # Take the first instance of a length 4 run
    .(start = frame[which.max(runs == 4)]),
    keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)
  ]

dt <- dt[
  movement_bounds,
  on = .(participant, block_num, trial_num),
  start := i.start
]

dt[frame < start, reaching := FALSE]
```

Movement end defined as the first when z_position is maximal.
